Title: How can EU economic policy meet the challenges of fairness and sustainable development?
text: Olli Rehn, Member of the Executive Board: How can EU economic policy meet the challenges of fairness and sustainable development? Helsinki, 5.6.2017. . Speech . Monday5 June 2017, 11:00 AM Olli Rehn from the Board of Directors Speech by the Bank of Finland at the Seminar of the Church Board helsinki, 5.6.2017 Esityskalvot (/globalassets/en/media-and-publications/speeches/documents/170605_rehn_kirkkohallitus.pdf) (PDF) . HOW CAN THE EU'S ECONOMIC POLICY RESPOND TO THE CHALLENGES OF FAIRNESS AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT? Good listeners, The document of the Conference of European Churches is an interesting ecumenical contribution to the question of how economic and political integration can be explored from the perspective of Christian ethics. The document rightly draws attention to the fact that the EU is not just an economic project. It has a very clear value base. According to the Treaty, the Union shall: "... rejects social organisation and discrimination, as well as promoting social justice and protection, equality between women and men, solidarity between generations and the protection of the rights of the child (and) promoting economic, social and territorial cohesion and solidarity in the Member States.' In order to promote these objectives, the Member States in the European Union have integrated political areas, such as: monetary policy, trade policy, competition and state aid policy and agricultural policy. On the other hand, in many policy areas only common standards have been agreed, but measures have been adopted to the national level. In social policy, for example, there is a great deal of so-called social policy. minimum harmonization. The division of labour between the EU and the Member States depends on the last resort, on the policy areas of the Member States being: in the Treaties, they wanted to be entrusted with being jointly managed or jointly standardised. The choices are guided by the principle of subsidiarity. The purpose of this principle is to ensure that the number of citizens as possible is made on a case-by-case basis. According to it, the EU will only take action when it is more effective than action at national or local level. In other words, the EU should be big on big things, small on small things. The focus is on the essentials, i.e. strengthening peace and security and supporting economic stability and better employment. But let us not get too involved in the activities of individual people or shackle companies. One example of major common challenges is the management of the refugee crisis. Is it not the case that the control of common borders, on the one hand, and the costs of asylum seekers, on the other, are in favour of cooperation and of sharing the financial burden between EU countries? The social dimension The European Union was born on the basis of economic cooperation, when the common market was a priority among the objectives. The social dimension began with the protection of the achievements of national labour and social policy. The aim was to ensure that competition in the common market did not lead to the erosion of the rights of workers ('race to the bottom'). The social dimension of the Myshmmi has expanded and is now an integral part of the Union. Two months ago, at the anniversary of the Treaty of Rome, EU leaders adopted a declaration that the aim was a 'social Europe', which: "On the basis of sustained growth, economic and social development will be promoted... while ensuring the integrity of its guerrilla market; a Union which rejects employment, discrimination, social organisation and social exclusion.' Promoting these objectives is also a matter of social and economic policy. The question of how economic and social policy is to be divided between the Member States and the Union is a key issue. In April 2017, the European Commission published a discussion paper outlining three options for the social dimension: 1. Limiting the social dimension to the free movement of labour force. In particular, the distribution of income and social security are subject to the exclusive power of the Member States. This would be motivated by a desire to reduce the burden on businesses and to improve the competitiveness of the Union at global level. However, the guerrilla market would ensure the continuity of social security and health care for the labour force moving from one country to another, but the minimum harmonisation of health, safety and labour standards would be dismantled. 2. The interconnection of the willing. Those Member States wishing to strengthen the common social policy (in relation to the previous option) could do so between them. 3. The eu as a whole would extend the social dimension in unison. The current division of competences between the Union and the Member States would be reconsidered and the social security of EU citizens would be more uniform and cofinanced. It is obvious that, even in the present and in the future, the political difficulties are moving towards the same level, let alone the common social security system, are considerable. The opposition concerns in particular the system, which would lead to social transfers of income between countries. This is due to the large differences between countries in terms of income levels and employment rates. The differences between the "north" and the "etelsn" are clear. Of the EU Member States, Britain, which has been most critical of the development of the social dimension, is the Member State of the Union. In the future, this may change the discussion positions of the Member States. As long as the economic situations in the Member States are very different and the national social angles are highlighted in the debate, progress on the social dimension will obviously be slow. Not just social policy It is clear that the social impact of EU action is not confined to the social dimension of the Union. In terms of the well-being of citizens and social justice, economic policy has a major impact. Successful economic policies can lead to a high level of unemployment and strong public finances capable of financing adequate social security and investment in education. A successful economic policy, on the other hand, leads to economic stability, crises, the economic security of citizens and the deterioration of the budgetary position of governments. The EU's role in economic policy is based on the fact that the decisions of the Member States have an impact on the other Member States. This is emphasised between the two parts of the monetary union, where the fact that one Member State finds itself in difficulties quickly spreads to the others. The member states of monetary union have a legitimate central interest in the fact that the economies of all the Member States are at the bottom of the table. When we talk about the social impact of the EU's economic policy, we need to consider the social impact of balancing economies. It is not socially irresponsible to take care of the sustainability of public finances in the Member States, but to ensure that the public finances are sustainable. The conditions under which this will take place will depend on the mutual trust of the partners of the monetary union in the last few years and on the role to be given to the Union in terms of pre-emptive problems and, as well as financial risk equalisation. As well as the recovery in the euro area, the new plans provided by the euro area reform are in the state of public finances. The overall deficit of the euro area has narrowed sharply. The government debt-to-GDP ratio has also declined. However, in most countries, public debt remains at high levels. The high level of indebtedness increases the country's vulnerability going forward. Reform of economic and monetary union resurfaces The 'casting defects' of economic and monetary union have been corrected, but much remains to be done. A debate is needed on how ambitious and coherent we want a stability union. The Commission opened the game last week. The list consists of completing the banking union in such a way that the economic stability of the financial markets would never destabilise the economies of the Member States in the same way as the 2008-2009 financial crisis and the subsequent euro area debt crisis occurred. The guiding principle will be the responsibility of the Member States for their own economic policies and budgetary finances, guided by the jointly elected Pelissnchje. Progress in the direction of sharing fiscal risks will depend on how the risk positions of the Member States are limited and their positions strengthened. The economic conditions for the development of the EU and the euro area are improving. Total output in the euro area has been growing for four years. The average employment rate in the region has also declined. However, the situation is still unsatisfactory, and the differences in the employment situation, particularly in the Member States, are worryingly large. Care for the workplace as a priority One of the key challenges of our time is the danger of dividing societies into the uninvolved. The danger of division is faced both at the social and material levels. Employment is one of the main reasons for this. It is also the form of organisation for which economic policy is most directly responsible. The worst are the consequences of long-term and youth struggle, both at the individual level and in social terms. The manifestations of this kind of employment are not just cyclical problems, but structural ones. Solving them therefore requires, above all, action to facilitate the adaptation of societies to structural changes resulting from technological and global market disruptions and the challenge of climate change. Much of this is the responsibility of the Member States, but the EU has a strong supporting role, for example in research, through social and regional development funds and in the form of a common higher education area. The means are investment in intellectual psychoma through education and research; developing the conditions for enterprise, e.g. by investing in infrastructure and reliable public institutions. Better coordination of social safety nets and the labour market is a key factor in managing economic transformation. On the role of churches The relationship of churches with politics is a complex philosophical question. The fact is that churches have a great deal of influence in society on issues of value, and politics reflects the values of citizens. Influence leads to responsibility. What could be the role of the churches in the debate on the direction of Europe and the development of the EU? Christian ethics emphasize the cohesion and equality of people. Human dignity does not depend on nationality or ethnicity. Lshimmsinen is lshimmsinen regardless of whether the hsn is Finnish, Greek or Syrian. The values of the European Union are along the same lines. If the current challenge for the EU is the intensification of the ideologies of nationalism and national selfishness, it is also a challenge to Christian ethics. I am not inviting churches to engage in political activity or to exert detailed influence on the development of the EU. Still, they can play a significant and mystic role. When the churches, as representatives of Christian ethics and the spirit of ecumenism, place an emphasis on justice and solidarity, and on human dignity, and thus our responsibility to our lHimmsis independent of nationality, the churches can play their part in counteracting nationalism in its narrowest and most negative manifestations. Title: The real economy matters: Europe from crisis to growth and reform
text: Board member Olli Rehn: The real economy matters: Europe from crisis to growth and reform. The UPI-FIIA seminar, Helsinki, 19 June 2017 . Speech . Monday19 June 2017, 2:30 PM Board member Olli Rehn Bank of Finland The UPI-FIIA seminar Helsinki, 19.6.2017 Presentation (/globalassets/fi/media-ja-julkaisut/puheet/documents/190617_olli_rehn_fiia-.pdf) . The real economy matters: Europe from crisis to growth and reform For the European Union, the past years since 2008 have been a real stress test, characterized by multiple crises. Nevertheless, Europe has been able to muddle through them, and without underestimating the remaining challenges the EU is now on a more stable footing. Today, I would like to start by identifying three trends that dominate the European political and economic scene for the moment. 1. Geopolitics is back, particularly since 2014, if not already since 2008. Russian power politics and reasonable doubts about president Trump's commitment for Europe underline the importance of moving forward in European security and defence cooperation. 2. Brexit will be bad, mainly for Britain. However, it has been crucial that the EU has not been consumed by it, and the Union has so far successfully insulated the Brexit mess from the rest of European policymaking. Brexit may also open up the possibility for deepening European integration in issues like security and immigration. 3. Economically, the Euro area has overcome the crisis and is now growing for the fifth year, since the spring of 2013. The number of jobs has now passed the 2008 peak, and unemployment continues to fall. This opens up new avenues for reform of the euro area. Ten days ago, the ECB published its latest macroeconomic projections, revising them upwards: the growth projection for this year is now 1.9% and almost the same rate is projected to continue for the next two years. Despite the much-improved performance of the euro area recently, we should not close our eyes from the remaining fragilities, such as: Unemployment. Although the number of jobs in the euro area has increased by 5 million since 2013, there are . very large differences in the unemployment rate across countries; Debt. Although the aggregate deficit for the euro area is now under 1.%, smaller than at any time after the . financial crisis, the level of accumulated debt in some countries is very high. Gross public debt in the euro area in its entirety is also elevated, exceeding 90% of GDP. The quality of the bankbalance sheets.Non-performing loans constitute a third major problem requiring a . solution. This is affecting Member States very unevenly, with Italy in a particular focus recently. The post-recession burden means that the euro area still have much work to do. At the same time, we must not forgetthe lessons of the crisis. One essential lesson is the macroeconomic significance of the stability of the financial system.This was grossly underestimated before the financial crisis. Now the situation is being remedied with the Banking Union, which has been under construction since 2012. Another lessonhas been the necessity of having a obig bazookao available as a means of dampening market panics. This is a very Keynesian lesson, and should not be a surprise to anybody: financial markets are characterized by oanimal spiritso, which are not always rational but sometimes prone to panic. Currently, the big bazooka needed to pacify the bond markets in case of turbulence consists of the ECB and the ESM together. By necessity, these involve a fair share of burden-sharing, even joint liability, sometimes damned by some people. The near-term focusshould be kept on the finalisation of the Banking Union. Finland supports a strong BankingUnion based on the bail-in principle, which is the framework with private sector or investor involvement in bearing losses for bank failures ahead of taxpayers. Bail-in can be made compatible with financial stability and well-capitalised banks. Legacy bank problems at national level should not be shifted on to the euro area level; the countries should themselves settle them. *** Recently, the political climate has become more positive for new initiatives towards reforming the functioning of the EMU. In late May, the European Commission published a reflection paper on deepening the EMU. The document contains a two-stage oroadmapo, with agenda for each stage (2017d19 and 2020d25) on three building blocks: First is a Financial Union, which would make euro area financial markets stronger, better integrated, and less dependent on the state of the finances of individual Member States. The second building block is Economic and Fiscal Union, which would strengthen the stability of Member Stateso economies, facilitate their convergence and the sustainability of their public finances. The third building block is a further reform of euro area governance and democratic accountability. This would improve the legitimacy of the EMU and make economic governance and policy coordination more effective. The roadmap includes many proposals that will require a great deal of discussion before any agreement, such as the creation of a European Deposit Guarantee Scheme or risk-free, bond-backed osafe assetso for the euro area. Even if these proposals may appear quite ambitious and even unrealistic to some, it is worth analysing them seriously. In Finland, we should be prepared for a scenario that the EU reforms will get under way next year. The direction is obvious. It is also regarding the Economic and Monetary Union towards deepening cooperation. In the coming debates, in my view we Finns should not embark on any kind of catenaccio defence, or stay watching from the sidelines; instead, we should seek to influence the destination and journey to where the work for Europeos renewal could lead in the coming years and decades. From the Finnish standpoint, I see the following as key issues: 1. As we are a member of the Euro, weod better make it sound and solid. There is no particular use for looking back and delving into the issues of the 1990os like "should I stay or should I go", but instead work for a solid structure for the euro area, which would enable it not only to survive but also to succeed in the 2020os and into the 2030os. 2. We mustlearn the right lessons from the debt crisis. It is a fact that the worst rock-bottom of the crisis coincided with the market turbulence that was only tamed once the European Stability Mechanism was created and the European Central Bank took up the role of the lender of last resort. The issue of moral hazard is important, but if we focus only on it, we can close the shop. The crisis was not only the result of the sins of individual member states, but of systemic shortcomings, especially in the banking and financial sector. Only once the financial repair got under way did the Euro area start growing again in 2013. 3. There is the false contradiction between "either federation or death".The Euro area will not become a political federation or transfer union, but it will either not break up just because of not becoming one. Instead, we should aim at building a solid stability union, where any increased solidarity is matched by corresponding responsibility of each member. In other words, reducingfinancial risks further is anecessary condition for the further sharing of risk I am thinking of e.g the safe assets proposed by the Commission. But next time, we have to set the bar higher than only omuddling througho. 4. Ultimately,the real economy matters.Member Stateso own responsibility for their economic policies for sustainable growth and employment is essential. The real economy is decisive, not only the institutions. As there is no political federation in sight, Member Stateso own economic policies and reforms will be vital when going forward. In all reflections, let us recall that, with regard to both the economy and security, Europeos ability to cope with and overcome the challenges that may arise does indeed matter for Finland. Therefore, it is in our own interest as well to make the Euro area function well and effectively. Olli Rehn (/en/other-pages/tag-search/?tagOlli Rehn) speech (/en/other-pages/tag-search/?tagspeech)

Airohan ei aitosuomalaisena suostunut puhumaan ruotsia ja Marskin suomi taas ei ollut tykieleksi kehuttava. Koulun ptteeksi kvelin usein "pivhoitoon" Graniittitaloon, jossa Mikkelin Autotarvike silloin sijaitsi. Autotarvikkeen konttori oli palvellut Mannerheimin keittin sotien aikana. Opin siell venjn kielen aakkoset konttoripllikkmme Aleksi Maksimenkon opettamana. Hn oli maahanmuuttaja, venlisten emigranttien suomalaistunut jlkelinen. Palaan viel Mannerheimin patsaaseen. Sen tarinahan ei suinkaan pttynyt Suur-Savon aukiolle. Lopulta vuonna 2002 valtuusto teki laajalla rintamalla ptksen ja patsas kuljetettiin komeasti pitkin Otavankatua ja Maaherrankatua oikealle paikalleen. Kaupunginvaltuuston puheenjohtajana toimi tuolloin Vuokko Rehn, mist olen rahtusen verran ylpe, jos sallitaan.  Mannerheim kvelee tnn kaupunkilaisten keskell, kuten pitkin. Arvoisat kuulijat, Mys Ruotsissa suhtautuminen Mannerheimiin riippui pitkn poliittisesta nkemyksest. Mutta samalla on kohdallaan sanoa, ett nykyisin hnt pidetn Suomea ja Euroopan historiaa ylipns tuntevien keskuudessa koko Pohjolan ja mys Ruotsin vapauden puolustajana. Ruotsin entinen p-ja ulkoministeri Carl Bildt on kirjoittanut paljon ja jopa ihaillen Mannerheimin merkityksest Ruotsille, Pohjolalle ja Euroopalle. Bildtille Mannerheim oli oman sukupolvensa suurin pohjoismainen valtiomies. Hn korostaa Mannerheimia lnsimaisten arvojen puolustajana ja kansainvlisen bolshevismin vastustajana. Mannerheimin idinkielell lainattuna: "Att han var antibolsjevik i varje cell och gen r sannerligen ingenting att frvnas ver."  Suomeksi: "Ett hn oli antibolshevikki joka solultaan ja geeniltn, ei ole todellakaan mikn ylltys." Bildt korostaa Suomen torjuntavoittojen ratkaisevaa merkityst Pohjolan vapauden kannalta. Hn muistuttaa, ett Ruotsinkin kehitys olisi mennyt sodan jlkeen kovin toista latua, jos puna-armeija olisi seisonut asemissa Tornionjoen itrannalla: kansankodissa olisi ollut tukalaa. Siksi Tienhaara ja Tali-Ihantala, jossa puna-armeijan vyry keskuussa 1944 pysytettiin, on Bildtille ei vain Suomen, vaan Pohjolan trkein lukko. Mutta Bildt tunnistaa mys Mannerheimin siteen keisarilliseen Venjn. Vuoden 1918 voittonsa jlkeen Mannerheim nki tehtvns viel sitkin suurempana. Lainaan Bildti: "Mannerheimin tavoitteet Venjll eivt olleet koskaan saksalaisia, ehk eivt edes suomalaisia, vaan hnen tavoitteensa Venjll olivat ennen muuta venlisi  sen keisarillisessa muodossaan." Historiantutkimuksessa on tullut muotiin esitt ns. kontrafaktuaalisia "ent jos olisi toimittu toisin?" -pohdintoja. Tss hengess Bildt ei kaihda sanomasta, ett Pietarin valloitus vuonna 1919 olisi ollut Mannerheimilta maailmanhistoriallinen teko, joka olisi voinut pysytt bolshevismin etenemisen alkuunsa ja sst ihmiskuntaa suurilta krsimyksilt. Bildt huipentaa arvionsa: Jos nin olisi kynyt, niin Mannerheim "ei olisi vain pohjoismaiden historian, vaan koko maailman historian suuri sankari". Hn kiteytt pohdintansa suomalaiseen korvaan hieman erikoisella tavalla: "Vaikka hnen agendansa oli venlinen, ksitteli se itsestn selvsti mys Suomea."  Siis mys Suomea; ei ensi sijassa Suomea. Mannerheimia ei voi kyll syytt yrityksen puutteesta Bildtin tavoitteen suuntaan. Hn yritti koota joukkoja ja aseita Suomesta ja Lnsi-Euroopasta ja saada Pietarin valtausyritykselle vuonna 1919 Suomen hallituksen tuen. Mihin hnen hankkeensa sitten pyshtyi? Kahdella sanalla: Suomen tasavaltaan. Presidentiksi juuri valittu K.J. Sthlberg asettui poikkiteloin. Yhdess etenkin ulkoministerins Rudolf Holstin ja muiden tasavaltalaisten johtajien, kuten Santeri Alkion, kanssa hn katsoi, ett ei ole Suomen kansallisen edun mukaista sitoa maan sotavoimia ja koko nuorta tasavaltaa niin epvarmaan seikkailuun. Presidentin tukena oli juuri Vin Tannerin johdolla eduskuntaan 80 edustajan voimin palannut parlamentaarinen SDP. Bildtill on varaa vet levell pensselill, kun taas Sthlberg ja Suomen nuoren tasavallan johtajat ajattelivat, eivt niinkn maailmanhistorian ihanteiden sinns epvarmaa toteuttamista, vaan Suomen kansan etua ja turvallisuutta  mielestni tysin perustellusti. Arvoisat kuulijat, Siin siis esimerkki lntisest arviosta. Ent sitten itinen naapurimme Venj, Mannerheimin 30-vuotinen kotimaa? Siell hneen suhtaudutaan huomattavasti ristiriitaisemmin. Ajatellaanpa vaikka vuodentakaista tapahtumaa Pietarissa, Mannerheimin henkisess kotikaupungissa  totta kai Mikkelin ohella. Satuin osallistumaan vuosi sitten keskuussa Pietarin talousfoorumiin, kun samaan aikaan muualla kaupungissa paljastettiin Venjn sotahistoriallisen seuran toimesta kenraaliluutnantti Gustaf Mannerheimin muistolaatta kunnianosoituksena hnen palveluksestaan Venjn armeijassa vuosina 18871918. Paikalla oli vaikutusvaltainen joukko venlisi pttji, kuten presidentti Putinin hallinnon pllikk, Tehtaankadun veteraani Sergei Ivanov, joka piti juhlapuheen, sek kulttuuriministeri Vladimir Medinski. Laatta joutui kuitenkin kommunistien ja kansallismielisten ankaran kritiikin kohteeksi ja tuhrittiin punaisella maalilla heti paljastamisen jlkeen. Laatan paljastamista oli yritetty jo vuotta aiemmin, mutta silloin hankkeesta luovuttiin. Presidentinhallinto ajoi ja puolusti laatan kiinnittmist. Mutta kun muistolaatta aina puhdistamisen jlkeen uudelleen tuhrittiin, se lopulta poistettiin. Nykyisin se sijaitsee Tsarskoje Selon sotamuseossa. Kiinnostavaa on, ett presidentti Vladimir Putinin hallinto kytti paljon pomaa Mannerheimin muistolaatan oikeuttamiseen. Mutta kyse ei ole vain Suomesta ja Mannerheimista, vaan on syyt laajentaa nkkulmaa. Vaikuttaa silt, ett Mannerheimin muistolaatta oli osa Venjn sotahistoriallisen seuran pyrkimyst kuroa umpeen vuoden 1917 vallankumouksessa syntynytt kahtiajakoa ja rakentaa historiallista sovintoa Venjn valkoisten ja punaisten vlille. Siin hengess Venjll on pystytetty muistomerkkej ensimmisen maailmansodan sankareille, jotka jivt eri puolille maan sisllissodassa. Useiden valkoisten kenraalien kunniaa on kyty palauttamaan, ja Mannerheim on yksi heist. Kyse on siis Venjn sispolitiikasta, nimenomaan sisisest historiapolitiikasta. Lnness ja Venjllkin osin ristiriitaista mainetta nauttiva kulttuuriministeri Medinski julkaisi viime syksyn Rossiiskaja Gazetassa (26.10.2016) artikkelin, jossa perustellaan muistolaatan oikeutus Mannerheimin ansioilla Venjn armeijassa ja tietyll maltillisuudella maiden vlisiss sodissa sek korostetaan hnen "venlisyyttn" uskollisuudella keisarille  olihan Mannerheimilla typydlln aina Nikolai II:n nimikirjoituksella varustettu valokuva. Eik siin kaikki: Medinski vertaa Mannerheimia Venjn armeijan suuriin ulkomaalaistaustaisiin kenraaleihin, kuten Borodinon ja Porin voittajaan Pjotr Bagrationiin, jotka olivat  lainaan naapurin kulttuuriministeri  "vereltn ulkomaalaisia, mutta sielultaan venlisi". Artikkelin lopuksi viitataan kyll mys Mannerheimin "toiseen elmn" Suomessa ja nostetaan esiin seikkoja, jotka osoittavat hnen aina ottaneen mys Venjn huomioon. Esimerkiksi se, ett Mannerheim kehotti Suomen valtiojohtoa talvisodan alla suostumaan rajattuihin alueluovutuksiin. Talvisodan torjuntavoittomme kuitataan artikkelissa puolestaan melko lakonisesti toteamalla, ett "Mannerheimin komennossa suomalaiset taistelivat talvisodassa urhoollisesti, mutta hvisivt". Jatkosodan ajalta Medinkski nostaa esiin viel suurempia ansioita, kuten sen, ett Mannerheim ei ollut tydell sydmell mukana liittoutumassa Saksan kanssa ja inhosi natseja. Medinskin mukaan Mannerheim onnistui "viekastelemalla ja vitkastelemalla" vlttmn Berliinin kskyjen noudattamisen, vaikka olikin koko ajan huolestunut Suomen joutuvan siit maksamaan. Mannerheim kieltytyi osallistumasta Leningradin piiritykseen ja suomalaiset joukot etenivt Kannaksella vain vanhalle rajalle asti. Tmhn ei ollut alun perin Neuvostoliiton sotilasjohdon oletus. Kuvaavaa on, mit Neuvostoliiton suurin sotilasjohtaja, marsalkka Georgi Zukov kirjoittaa muistelmissaan: "Karjalan kannaksella, entisell valtakunnanrajallamme, olivat suomalaiset joukot, jotka odottivat sopivaa hetke rynntkseen Leningradiin pohjoisesta." Muistolaatta nosti pintaan kysymyksen siit, milloin Mannerheim viimeksi kvi Pietarissa ja milloin loppui hnen palveluksensa Venjn armeijassa. Muistolaatan mukaan oikea vuosiluku on 1918. Olin viime kesn asti siin ksityksess, ett Mannerheim kvi viimeist kertaa Pietarissa joulukuussa 1917, eik sen jlkeen en koskaan omaan metropoliinsa palannut. Asiaan on sittemmin saatu selkoa, ja osoittautui, ett olin ilmeisesti vrss. Mannerheim on muistelmissaan tst kovin epmrinen, hmrkin  mist syyst, sit en osaa ptell. Tuoreissa kirjoissaan sek professori Henrik Meinander ett toimittaja Matts Dumell ovat ptyneet siihen, ett Mannerheim kvi Pietarissa viel tammikuun alussa 1918. Tiivistettyn tapahtumat nyttvt edenneen nin: Svinhufvudin johtama valtuuskunta sai Leninin ja kansankomissaarien neuvoston tunnustuksen Suomen itsenisyydelle 31.12.1917. Kun Mannerheimin synnyinmaa Suomi nin oli saanut Venjn viralliselta hallitukselta itsenisyystunnustuksen, hnen lojaliteettinsa keisaria ja Venj kohtaan ei en ollut voimassa. Seuraavana pivn 1.1.1918 Mannerheim kirjoitti Helsingiss erokirjeen Venjn armeijasta ja lhti illan mittaan tai seuraavan pivn aamulla junalla kohti Pietaria. Erokirje on leimattu saapuneeksi Pietarin yleisesikuntaan 2.1.1918 ja tallennettu Venjn armeijan arkistoon. On vaikea uskoa, ett mikn posti olisi vallankumouksen kaoottisissa oloissa vienyt kirjeen noin nopeasti perille, mik puoltaa oletusta siit, ett Mannerheim on voinut kyd sen itse sinne toimittamassa. Samalla matkalla Mannerheim tapasi mys Ranskan sotilasasiamiehen ja muita tahoja, joilta hn pyrki saamaan aseita ja tukea Suomen vapaustaistelulle. Mannerheim palasi Helsinkiin ilmeisesti 6. tai 7.1.1918; ensimminen varma dokumentti hnen oleskelustaan Helsingiss on pivlt 8.1.1918. Pian sen jlkeen hn nousi sotilaskomitean johtoon, siirtyi Pohjanmaalle  ja loppu on Suomen historiaa. Mutta Mannerheimin ja Venjn armeijan yhteinen tarina ei pty viel thn. Eroanomuksen jlkeen kenraali evp:t, joka oli palvellut 30 vuotta armeijassa, kohdeltiin hyvin: Venjn vallassa oleva hallitus  siis punaisen Neuvosto-Venjn kansankomissaarien neuvosto  mynsi 25.2.1918 pivtyll ptkselln Mannerheimille 3761 ruplan elkkeen. Muuan venlinen vaikuttaja totesi thn viime kesn erss pivllispydss: "Aika paljon riesaa tuo puna.armeijan elkelinen pystyi puna-armeijalle myhemmin talvisodassa aiheuttamaan"! Arvoisat kuulijat, Tst pstn siihen perimmiseen kysymykseen, mik oli Mannerheimin painavin, trkein pts Suomen kannalta, suomalaisesta nkkulmasta. Suomen itsenistymisen ja itsenisyyden silyttmisen kannalta Mannerheim teki useita ptksi, jotka ovat osoittautuneet ratkaiseviksi. Tammikuussa 1918 hn rohkeni kulkea itsenisesti vastavirtaan ja nosti kissan pydlle vaatien Sotilaskomiteaa siirtymn heti Vaasaan tukialuetta rakentamaan  yhdennelltoista hetkell. Venlisten aseistariisunta Pohjanmaalla tammikuussa 1918 loi perustan hallituksen armeijan rakentamiselle ja lnsimaisen elmnmuodon voitolle Suomessa. Pietarin sotaretki v. 1919 jo ksiteltiin  siin tasavalta suojeli kenraalia. Marraskuussa 1939 Mannerheimin suositus rajatuista alueluovutuksista ji toteutumatta. Siihen sisltyi Ahvenanmaan linnoittaminen yhdess Ruotsin kanssa, mill thdttiin Suomen ja Ruotsin puolustusliittoon. Hanke kuitenkin kariutui Ruotsin hallituksen vetydytty siit. Pidttytyminen alueluovutuksista ja valmius taistella oli Suomelle ilmeisesti lopulta parempi vaihtoehto ja auttoi maatamme vlttmn Baltian tien, joka johti puolen vuosisadan raskaaseen miehitykseen. Kyky johtaa viisi vuotta talvi-ja jatkosotaa kahteen torjuntavoittoon oli jo ikklt sotilaalta valtava strateginen suoritus. Silti kenties painavimpia  tai ainakin vaikeimpia  oli kaksi rauhaa rakentavaa ratkaisua. Yksi Mannerheimin kaukonkisimmist ptksist oli jtt hykkmtt Leningradiin vuosina 19411943, jolloin se olisi ollut Suomelle sotilaallisesti mahdollista. Realistisesti ajatellen tm pts ilmeisesti ssti suomalaisilta paljon verta, hike ja kyyneli sin puolen vuosisadan pitkn kautena 19431990, jolloin Neuvostoliitto oli voimansa tunnossa. Ehk lopulta kaikkein painavin pts oli silti se, ett Mannerheimin onnistui johtaa Suomi rauhaan kesll 1944, vaikka ptksentekoa vaivasi ajoittainen epvarmuus, kuten viime vuosien historiantutkimus on osoittanut. Risto Rytin lailla Mannerheim otti siin mys suuren henkilkohtaisen riskin joutua vedetyksi sotasyyllisyysoikeudenkyntiin. Neuvostoliitto oli kuitenkin ilmoittanut jo jatkosodan aikana Ruotsin kautta, ettei se tule puuttumaan Mannerheimiin. Tmn lupauksen toisti valvontakomission johtaja Savonenkov tammikuussa 1946, pari kuukautta ennen Mannerheimin eroa presidentin tehtvst. Paasikivi kirjasi pivkirjaansa 26.1.1946, mit Savonenkov oli sanonut Mannerheimille: "Savonenkov oli saanut Moskovasta tehtvksi ilmoittaa Mannerheimille, ett, katsoen Mannerheimin ansioihin rauhan tekemisess, he eivt tule milln tavalla sekottamaan hnt oikeudenkyntiin sotasyyllisyydest, riippumatta siit, onko hn presidenttin tai tuleeko hn eroamaan." Kuten ers historiaa hyvin tunteva ystvni totesi, tm on siklikin merkittv historiallinen poikkeama, ettei Stalin aina pitnyt tapanaan pit kiinni aivan kaikista lupauksistaan. Arvoisat kuulijat, Mannerheimin ratkaisuissa korostui strateginen ja historiallinen ajattelu. Geopolitiikaksikin sit voidaan kutsua, mik on hyv muistaa nyt, kun geopolitiikka on palannut kansainvlisiin suhteisiin. Venjn imperiumin kasvattina Mannerheim luki Euroopan historian suuria virtoja ja geopoliittisten mannerlaattojen liikkeit aikansa muita suomalaisia paremmin. Talvisodan rauhanneuvotteluissa tm auttoi nkemn lnnen lupaaman avun merkityksen. Moskovan silmiss etenkin Ranskan puuttuminen konfliktiin uhkasi muuttaa sen laajemmaksi selkkaukseksi lnsivaltojen kanssa. Jatkosodan aikana se auttoi, viimeistn Stalingradin jlkeen, nkemn Saksan tappion ja varautumaan irtautumiseen sodasta, mihin Mannerheim alkoi eduskuntaa valmistella vuodesta 1943 lhtien. Mannerheimin realismia soveltaen Suomen turvallisuuspolitiikan trkein haaste on suhde Venjn. Meill on Venjn kanssa sama raideleveys, mutta eri arvopohja: viittaan etenkin oikeusvaltioon ja kansanvaltaan. Niinp Suomen tuoreessa ulko-ja turvallisuuspoliittisessa selonteossa otetaan huomioon Venjn paluu voimapolitiikkaan. Osallistuin selonteon valmisteluun Tasavallan Presidentti Sauli Niinistn johtaman ulko-ja turvallisuuspoliittisen ministerivaliokunnan jsenen. Selonteossa todetaan ulkopolitiikan ensisijaisuus ja pyrkimyksemme hyviin naapuruussuhteisiin. Kansallisen puolustuksemme uskottavuuden kannalta korostetaan puolustusvoimien entist nopeampaa reagointivalmiutta, samoin hybridiuhkiin varautumista. Lpi linjan hydynnetn kansainvlist yhteistyt ja pidetn yll mahdollisuutta hakea Nato-jsenyytt. Vakauspolitiikkaa on sekin, ett Venj huolehtii turvallisuuseduistaan Suomen suunnalla parhaiten toimimalla maltillisesti. Suomen ei kannata itse rajoittaa liikkumavaraansa lnteen, eik siten heikent nit pidkkeit. Hyvt ystvt, Palataan lopuksi alun kysymykseen: Kenen Mannerheimin linjalla, siis? Annetaan appiukkoni Einari Hakkaraisen vastata. Hn menehtyi kymmenkunta vuotta sitten kotonaan Juankoskella ja oli sit sukupolvea, joka joutui viettmn viisi vuotta elmstn talvi-ja jatkosodan rintamilla. Einarilla oli kuolemaansa asti seinll snkyns kummallakin laidalla kehystetty valokuvataulu. Vasemmalla Mannerheimin virallinen valokuva, marsalkansauvoineen. Oikealla 20 vuoden takainen lehtileike, jossa virallinen kuva Urho Kekkosesta. Sissipataljoona 4:n ja Kollaan veteraani oli loppuun asti sek Mannerheimin ett Kekkosen linjan miehi. Olen samaa mielt sotaveteraani Einarin kanssa. Rauhaa pit vahvistaa ennakoivasti, yhteistyll. Jos mahdollista, naapurin kanssa sovitaan. Jos se ei onnistu, pannaan kampoihin, yksin tai yhdess. Maata ja vapautta puolustetaan niill konsteilla, joita kulloinkin on kytettviss. Tm on nhdkseni Mannerheimin linjan ydin. Se on mys Suomen pitk linja, jonka varaan kansallinen turvallisuutemme jatkossakin perustuu. Kiitos. *** LOPPU*** Keskeisi lhteit: Ainola, Olli, Mannerheim halusi vallata Pietarin. Title: Speech at the Kivennava Forest and Rural Evenings
text: Board member Olli Rehn: Speech at the Kivennava forest and rural evenings. Juankoski, 4.8.2017. . Speech . Friday 4August 2017, 7:00 PM Board of Directors Jssen Olli Rehn Bank of Finland Speech in Kivennava rural and forest bridges Juankoski 4.8.2017 Dear Iltamavski, good women and men, Thank you for inviting tsnne Juankoski (my wife Merja asked me to say nsin) to Kivennava and to an event that has already become czech. Rural and forest bridges 18th time. In its own way, the history of the farm, the current agritourism company Kivennava, also mirrors the history of 100-year-old Finland. Aino and Armas Kshsnen, the parents of the current owner of Kivinnava, Martti Kshssen, arrived in northeastern Savon from Kivenava in Karelia. In 1939, they found themselves in the middle of the war at their home in Kivennava. The stone pole has another connection to Tsnne Savo, since it was the JR7, formed mostly by Savonian men, who defended in the middle of 1944 by the Red Army in the fierce battles of the Great Hyskksyksess Kivennava siiranmsen, so that the Panzer Division had time for the Kuuterselksn counterattack and otherwise perssntyvs fieldts army was able to regroup on the VKT line, and the enemy was finally stopped at the Crossroads, yrspsssss and Tali-Ihantala. The JR7 commanded by Colonel Adolf Ehrnrooth, the traditional brigade unit of the Savo Brigade, is probably the one that has been awarded the most Mannerheim crosses by the army. After the long years of evacuees, the Kshssten road just ran to snne Muuruvesi. Since then, Muuruvesis became part of Juankoski when it was merged with Ssyneinen into the triad Juankoski in 1970. At the beginning of this year, Juankoski joined Kuopio, but in our family, of course, the truth has not been swallowed up by sys, and the wife still sings to her birthplace when she drives to her birthplace in the words of Juice Leskinen: oJuankoski here I come! o. The Kshksste farm has also undergone the restructuring of the Finnish countryside. The company, which started as a dairy farm, switched production to a beef cattle farm in 1972, when Martti took over the reins. And in 1988, kaija and Marti's collaboration was the birth of a Gasthouse-type agrithouse-type agritourism company, which was naturally named Kivennapa, the founder of the family's history. Hyvst ystsvst, On the evening, I thought I would reflect on the future of the Finnish countryside, the growth and stubbornness of our economy, and the indebtedness of our economy. There was talk of structural change in rural areas back in the 70s, and that is what they are talking about. There are many reasons for this. Partly natural, such as an increase in agricultural productivity. Partly home-made, such as the constant pushing down of consumer prices while the cost of production has not fallen, why is it in the wage bag of domestic food producers. At the same time, food exports to Vensjs are blocked and new markets to China and Japan are only just opening up. It is no wonder, then, that there have been many weighty speeches in favour of domestic food production during the current summer. For example, just over a week ago, Savon Sanomat headlined its headline: Agriculture can become more expensive than gold. The writing reflected on the variations in sside. In Finland, the current summer has been notoriously chilly and humid, while the rest of Europe has been ravaged by heat and drought in some places. The question is, can we safeguard our food self-sufficiency? According to experts interviewed by YLE, it is not possible to import food from elsewhere to Finland for 10 to 30 years, as the drought problem worsens, for example, in Central and Eastern Europe. Kalle Hoppula, an expert at the Natural Resources Institute Finland, estimates that if domestic food production were to be shut down, there could be big problems for 10 years. We must be prepared for the fact that food is simply not available. In the future, Finland will not be a country that buys food elsewhere, but we will be a country that sells food elsewhere," says Hoppula. d There will certainly be other nskemyksis, but there are also questions that need to be seriously considered, both in terms of climate change and our national security of supply. Food is a huge business around the world. For example, the UN Food and Agriculture Council (FAO) has estimated that demand for food will increase by as much as 60 70% by 2050. The reasons are growth, urbanisation, prosperity and changes in eating habits in developing countries. This is a big opportunity for Finland, as we are in excellent conditions for producing clean and ecologically sustainable food products. But consumers are demanding and want information about the origin of food, production methods, environmental responsibility and the whole quality chain, from the field to the consumer's food. Ecologically produced food is clearly a selling point. In the future, there will also be more conglomerates in rural areas, combining traditional rural livelihoods with the activities generated by decentralised energy production and biomass processing. Despite the difficult times, the countryside has been able to regenerate. New generations bring and create new energy on farms. There are reasons why the will to create something new is actively encouraged. It is the kind of realistic environmental and entrepreneurial reason on which it is good to build Finland. What, then, is the state of Finland's national economy in the middle of 2017? In short: The Finnish economy is growing and employment is improving, but there is a lot of work to be done. The Finnish economy has undergone a change of focus: in addition to domestic demand and construction investments, exports and productive investment have been linked to growth. Finland's growth rate is currently among the fastest in the euro area. However, the boom in Finland began with a d catching up. There has been a lot of talk about the Kiky Agreement in the middle. The other day, when I was in charge of the kiky negotiations on the government side, I have now d a year after the conclusion of the agreement d tried to make a decision on the effects of the agreement. I understand that the zero line of wage increases and the haggling over benefits have affected many people, such as the abandonment of holiday pay in the public sector. On the other hand, the tax cuts have compensated for the losses and prolonged the excess of domestic demand, which has been the case with economic policy. However, according to estimates by the Ministry of Finance's economists, the employment rate will improve thanks to the kiky agreement by about 35,000 tysills, while the kiky agreement will now restore the competitiveness of Finnish tysn and production to the level of competitor countries. It means a lot to the Finns. Tys, on the other hand, is the best form of social security and is the best form of social security. Thanks to the Kiky agreement, the price of Finnish tysn will decrease in the lshi years clearly in relation to competitor countries. In 2017 d 2019, labour costs in Finland are estimated to rise by around 2%, compared to an average of just over 6% in the euro area (SP and ECB forecasts, Mid 2017). This is a very significant repair shop. On the other hand, the decline in competitiveness at the time of the onset of the financial crisis was also exceptionally strong. The gap that has arisen then cannot be bridged by means of the Kiky Agreement. In the light of the smsn vslisaldo, I marvel at the kiky agreement among the Finnish commentator corps inclined to vshsttelys nihilism. The political memory is short, they say, but the short one is also the market memory of the commentary. When you remember the atmosphere at the tys market in the autumn and winter of 2015d16, the action and the threats of strikes, you don't need a huge imagination nskemssn, that without kikys we might now be performing from opersus to bencho spirit and some kind of hustle and bustle at the tys market. That doesn't mean that the world is a ready-made d or even a Finnish tys market system. I still believe more in evolution than in revolution. The movement is the same as the psmsssrs, when local agreement is taken forward and the negotiating system is reformed. Autumn is a round of unions. The Finnish model based on the ability to pay wages in the export sector did not emerge in theory, but it can be done together. The negotiators are very much on guard for Finland's growth and stupidity. On the side of the improved picture of the Finnish economy, there is indebtedness. This applies to both public finances and private citizens and households. Although the interest expenses on public debt are reduced in proportion to GDP, due to the persistent deficit of the central government and municipalities, the ratio of public debt to GDP will increase by one and will be around 67% in 2019. The intensification of growth slows down the growth of debt, but not enough to fold it in the sikh years. There will be plenty of work to be done in the 2020s as well. Households in Finland are already indebted to their income. This exposes both the financial system and the economy to risks. The ratio of household debt to income has doubled since 20 years ago. Indebtedness is clearly higher than before the recession of the 90s1. Excessive household indebtedness has been one of the main factors behind the financial and economic crises. That is why we have started talking about macroprudential policy, which has come alongside traditional monetary policy. Macroprudential measures are aimed at curbing over-indebtedness. The loan ceiling introduced in 2016 aims to strengthen household buffers. In turn, the Financial Supervisory Authority's decision to increase the risk weights of mortgages increases banks' claims and strengthens their solvency. The growth of the mortgage stock in Finland has remained moderate in recent years compared to the growth at the beginning of the millennium. By contrast, the growth rate of consumer credit to households has picked up as the economic recovery has boosted consumer confidence. In recent years, household consumption expenditure has grown faster than disposable income. In mid-2017, the stock grew by 7.4%, up from 4.4% in the same period a year earlier. In particular, unsecured consumer credit has increased significantly. The concern about the leniency of expensive consumer credit is justified by the fact that consumer credit often goes into a vicious circle of payments. According to customer data, approximately 941,000 payments were recorded for private persons in January-Midst 2017, which is more than 100,000, or 12% more than a year earlier. Efforts have been made to curb lending in the microcredit market by capping interest rates on loans, but this constraint has been circumvented2. Although the majority of consumer credit is taken from banks, there is a constant increase in the number of channels providing credit. Lending has grown both through online foreign credit providers, microcredit companies and new peer-to-peer lending services. The fragmented legislation also makes it difficult to keep track of consumer credit. Rapid growth in lending and aggressive advertising may extend credit to customers with poor ability to repay high-interest loans. At the moment, consumer credit does not pose a risk to the stability of the financial system. However, households are required to be vigilant in managing their own indebtedness. The consumer credit portfolio and loan channels are developing at a rapid pace, so it is worth asking: Is current knowledge of consumer credit and its market sufficient? Due to the factors mentioned above, the time seems to be ripe for the creation of a positive credit register in Finland. It would make it possible to better monitor indebtedness and to address possible excesses. The Financial Supervisory Authority and the Bank of Finland will investigate the cooperation with the financial sector. The clearest way forward would be to have a positive credit register by law. In addition, it is important to ensure that citizens' financial literacy is sufficient as digitalisation shapes the financial markets. Payment is becoming partly an unobtrusive action that takes place behind the purchase transaction. Although the easing of shopping is also a mystery, it is possible for the consumer to understand the budgetary constraints of the payment process. This can accelerate over-indebtedness by not running out of banknotes in the wallet as a physical budget constraint. The new challenges of paying these will be addressed by the Bank of Finland's Payments Council. In addition, we cooperate with the financial sector and participate in financial literacy training for teachers. Hyvst ystsvst, All in all, the general characteristics of the Finnish economy are temporarily good. Employment has begun to improve as a result of growth, which can be supported by reforms. The ECB's light monetary policy contributes to supporting growth and employment. But there are brakes on over-indebtedness. There are ways to tackle the excessive indebtedness of individual citizens, especially young people, in a proactive manner so as not to lose a large part of an entire generation. In all serious words, I wish you a happy evening! However, I do not encourage a joyful celebration of consumption, but rather the sizing of expenditure according to income and, at most, moderate indebtedness. d Good for the rest of the summer! *** 1 Indebtedness figures: in 1989/1990 debt/income approx. 88%; at the beginning of 2000, debt/income 64%; at the end of 2016, debt/income 127%. 2 The interest rate cap has been circumvented, inter alia, by offering larger loans and limits that are not covered by the current interest rate cap. board (/en/other-pages/tag-search/?tagjohtokunta) Board jssen (/en/other-pages/tag-search/?tagJohtokunnan jssen) speech (/en/other-pages/tag-search/?tagpuhe)

Asiakastiedon mukaan yksityishenkilille kirjattiin tammi-keskuussa 2017 noin 941 000 maksuhirimerkint, joka on yli 100 000 eli 12 % enemmn kuin vuotta aiemmin. Pienlainamarkkinoiden lainanantoa on pyritty hillitsemn asettamalla lainoille korkokatto, mutta tt rajoitetta on kierretty2. Vaikka suurin osa kulutusluotoista otetaan yh pankeilta, syntyy luottoa tarjoavia kanavia jatkuvasti lis. Luotonanto on kasvanut sek verkossa toimivien ulkomaisten luotontarjoajien, pienlainayhtiiden ett uusien vertaislainapalveluiden kautta. Mys pirstaleisen lainsdnnn vuoksi kulutusluottojen seuraaminen on vaikeaa. Luotonannon nopea kasvu ja aggressiivinen mainonta saattavat laajentaa luottojen myntmisen asiakkaisiin, joiden kyky maksaa takaisin korkeakorkoisia lainoja on heikko. Tll hetkell ei viel nyt silt, ett kulutusluotoista aiheutuisi rahoitusjrjestelmn vakautta uhkaavaa riski. Kotitalouksilta kuitenkin vaaditaan tarkkaavaisuutta oman velkaantumisensa hallinnassa. Sen avulla velkaantuneisuutta voitaisiin paremmin seurata ja mahdollisiin ylilynteihin puuttua. Finanssivalvonta ja Suomen Pankki tulevat selvittmn tt yhteistyss finanssialan kanssa. Selkein tapa edet asiassa olisi st positiivisesta luottorekisterist lailla. Tmn lisksi on trke huolehtia siit, ett kansalaisten talouslukutaito silyy riittvll tasolla, kun digitalisaatio muokkaa rahoitusmarkkinoita. Maksaminen on muuttumassa osin huomaamattomaksi, ostotapahtuman taustalla tapahtuvaksi toimeksi. Vaikka ostosten teon helpottuminen on mynteist, niin maksamisen hviminen ostotapahtuman sisn voi hmrt kuluttajan ymmrryst budjettirajoitteistaan. Tm voi vauhdittaa ylivelkaantumista, kun setelien loppuminen lompakosta ei en toimi fyysisen budjettirajoitteena. Nihin maksamisen uusiin haasteisiin pyritn vastaamaan Suomen Pankin vetmss maksuneuvostossa. Lisksi teemme yhteistyt finanssialan kanssa ja osallistumme opettajille suunnattuun talousosaamisen koulutukseen. Hyvt ystvt, Kaiken kaikkiaan Suomen talouden yleiset nkymt ovat tll hetkell hyvt. Tyllisyys on alkanut kohenemaan kasvun myt, mit voidaan uudistuksilla tukea. EKP:n kevyt rahapolitiikka osaltaan tukee kasvua ja tyllisyytt. Mutta ylivelkaantumiseen on lydettv jarruja. Yksittisten kansalaisten, etenkin nuorten, liialliseen velkaantumiseen on lydettv keinoja puuttua ennakoivasti, ettei menetet isoa osaa kokonaisesta sukupolvesta. Nill lievsti vakavillakin sanoilla toivotan teille iloisia iltamia! En silti kannusta iloiseen kulutusjuhlaan, vaan menojen mitoittamiseen tulojen mukaan ja korkeintaan maltilliseen velkaantumiseen.  Hyv loppukes kaikille! *** 1 Velkaantumisen lukuja: vuonna 1989/ 1990 velka/tulot n. 88 %; vuoden 2000 alussa velka/tulot 64 %; vuoden lopussa 2016 velka/tulot 127 %. 2 Korkokattoa on kierretty mm. tarjoamalla suurempia lainoja ja limiittej, joita nykyinen korkokatto ei koske. johtokunta (/en/other-pages/tag-search/?tag=johtokunta) Johtokunnan jsen (/en/other-pages/tag-search/?tag=Johtokunnan jsen) puhe (/en/other-pages/tag-search/?tag=puhe)

text: Olli Rehn, Member of the Executive Board: The euro area resolved the crisis ? now is the time for reform. Article in The Canal magazine. . Publication . Thursday17August2017, 2:00 PM Olli Rehn, Member of the Board of Directors, Bank of Finland Article in Kanava magazine 5/2017 THE EURO AREA RESOLVED THE CRISIS ? NOW IS THE TIME FOR REFORM When the reform of the European Union begins, Finland will not be able to take up hedgehog defence, but take the initiative to strengthen the euro area. The last decade has been a real stress test for the European Union. The years since the 2007 ? 2008 financial crisis were triggered by numerous crises. Despite the great resistances, the English term muddling through ?m?n has somehow survived aptly, k??ntyen best known in Finnish as "r?mp front p?in". Without underestimating the challenges that lie ahead, Europe now has a lot of ground under its feet, which gives the Union a basis for reform and thus better manages its bread and butter. But at the same time, there are new challenges. The political and economic landscape of our continent is currently dominated by a number of developments, some of them cross-cutting. Geopolitics has made a comeback, especially since 2014, if not 2008. Ven?j?'s policy of power and the appropriate ephemles about President Donald Trump's commitment to Europe underline the progress made in the European security and defence cooperation. Europeans are more on their own in security policy than they have been in the past. Brexit is a big nuisance, especially for the UK. Unlike the pel?t, the EU has succeeded in staying united and encapsulating the guerrilla Brexit milling of the island kingdom apart from the rest of the European parliament. On the other hand, Brexit could open up opportunities for deeper European integration on major issues such as security, immigration and external border control. In economic terms, the euro area has clearly overcome the crisis. In 2013, the euro area experienced a fragile recovery, but then proved to be sustainable, and growth is currently continuing for five years. The number of jobs is now above the top level of 2008, and the employment rate continues to do so. Cheshkin gives additional room for manoeuvre for the reform of the euro area. THE FOCUS OF THE HOLIDAYS IS THE REASONS FOR COMPLETING THE BANKING UNION. The heavy burden of a recession means that there is still a lot to be done in the euro area. It is said that generals are always preparing for the previous war. Yes, but there have been many general lessons to be learned from the eurozone's debt crisis, which are not to be forgotten even in the heat of the boom. In the boom, people often fall into the trap of thinking that "it's different." But most of the laws of the economy are also in the era of the new economy, digitalisation and the four-year industrial revolution, or why not the current fashion term. Why, then, is the most fundamental lesson of the crisis? It is important for the stability of the financial system for the economy as a whole ? i.e. for the growth and employment of the economy as a whole. Vasta kun rahoitusjrjestelmn remontti oli saatu kunnolla kyntiin, euroalue alkoi jlleen kasvaa vuonna 2013. 3. Liian usein, ja usein propagandasyist, esitetty vastakkainasettelu "joko liittovaltio tai kuolema" on vr eik perustu tosiasioihin. Euroalueesta ei tule liittovaltiota eik tulonsiirtounionia, mutta se ei myskn hajoa vain sen takia, ettei siit tule sellaista. Tarvitaan sek realismia ett mrtietoisuutta. Realistiseksi pmrksi kannattaisi asettaa sellaisen lujalla pohjalla toimivan vakausunionin rakentaminen, jossa kaikkien osapuolten oma vastuu korostuu ja on ehto yhteisten toimien lismiselle. Toisin sanoen rahoitusvakauteen liittyvien riskien vhentminen edelleen on edellytys riskien tasaamiselle. Tm ennakkoehto sopii hyvin mys pankkiunionin puuttuvien elementtien pystyttmiseen. Jotta pankkikriisej voidaan est ennakolta ja tarvittaessa ratkaista tehokkaasti, kriisinhoidon selknojaksi tarvittaisiin jsenvaltioiden takaamaa varautumisjrjestely. Yhteisen talletussuojan osalta kompromissiksi on esitetty kansallisten rahastojen takausrahastoa. Se tarkoittaisi kansallisten talletussuojarahastojen yhteisvastuullista jlleenvakuuttamista, omavastuun ylittvlt osaltaan, kuten tohtori Vesa Vihril tavoitetta on kuvannut. Euroalue kaipaa siis vahvempaa perustaa. Siin kannattaa keskitty rahoitusvakauteen: jos se kyetn pankkiunionilla varmistamaan, voidaan valtioiden mahdollisia velkakriisej hoitaa sujuvammin ilman jatkuvaa pelkoa koko rahoitusjrjestelmn saastumisesta. Olisiko liikaa ajatella, ett seuraavan kriisin varalta euroalueen yhteisen suoriutumisen rima asetettaisiin korkeammalle kuin vain "jotenkuten selviytymisen" tasolle? Rmpiminen kun ei osoita kovin korkeaa kunnianhimoa, eik itseluottamusta. REAALITALOUS RATKAISEE, EIVTK VAIN INSTITUUTIOT Loppujen lopuksi jsenmaiden vastuu omasta talouspolitiikastaan  kestvst kasvusta ja tyllisyydest  on avainasemassa. Pohjimmiltaan reaalitalous ratkaisee, eivtk vain instituutiot. Koska nkpiiriss ei ole federaatiota, jsenvaltioiden omat, kestv kasvua tukevat uudistukset ovat keskeisi. Jatkossakin Euroopan menestyminen on Suomen kannalta kaikkea muuta kuin yhdentekev asia. Silloin kun Euroopassa on sodittu ja talous on taantunut, Suomella on mennyt huonosti. Silloin kun Euroopassa on vallinnut rauha ja talous on kasvanut, Suomella on mennyt hyvin. Sen vuoksi on mit perusteellisemmin Suomen ja suomalaisten omankin edun mukaista varmistaa, ett euroalue toimii hyvin ja tytt tehtvns kestvn kasvun tukena. Title: Finland's growth story and corporate productivity
text: Speech by Olli Rehn, Member of the Board of Directors: Finland's growth story and the productivity of companies. Entrepreneurship psivsn pss event. Helsinki, 5.9.2017. . Speech . Tuesday 5September 2017, 2:00 PM Olli Rehn, Member of the Board of Directors, Bank of Finland Keynote speech at the Entrepreneurship sivsn pss festival Finland's growth story and company productivity Korjaamo, Helsinki 5.9.2017 (PDF) (/globalassets/en/media-and-publications/speeches/documents/2017-09-05_yrittajan-paiva_final_olli_rehn.pdf) FINLAND'S GROWTH STORY AND COMPANIES' PRODUCTIVITY Dear entrepreneurs and representatives of enterprises, ladies and gentlemen, The Finnish economy is finally experiencing a period of growth. Over the past year, the good news about individual enterprises has been confirmed as growth for the economy as a whole. Growth has broadened from consumption-driven demand to investment and export revival. The stapleships of Finnish companies are clearly better than before. Kaskimailta digiyhteiskunnaksi This is a fitting opportunity to look at the rise of 100-year-old Finland from kaskima and tar burning to a digital society, where many companies from the early days of industrialization are still part of our story d and newer entrants bring new winds to our future success. In the mid-1800s, Finland was a ksyhs country compared to other countries. By many measures, our standard of living has improved significantly since then. The standard of living of Finns measured by national product per capita 1on 150 years increased about 25-fold. Until recently, the growth in the standard of living of Finns has accelerated. From 1860 onwards, it took 50 years for the standard of living to double. Despite the wars, the next doubling was achieved within 40 years. After the wars, economic growth accelerated, and the standard of living doubled twice in 20 years. However, the pace has slowed down. It has to do with the slowdown in productivity growth, which I will come back to in a moment. One of the key factors behind Finland's 150-year rise in living standards has been our country's integration into the international economy. Industrialisation has been based on international trade and the specialisation it has enabled. The forest industry, whose raw materials are abundant in Finland, is a prime example. The same applies to the metal and technology industries and, for example, to the software and game industries. International trade in services has also grown. Free trade and liberal international relations have been one of the cornerstones of Finland's growth story. That is why we cannot quietly follow the fact that the creators of that liberal regime, the United States and Britain, are now themselves undermining its foundations. In this situation, the European Union has consistently defended multilateral trade arrangements and concluded new bilateral free trade agreements. Similar speeches have been heard from China in favour of free trade. Globalisation has not yet taken a step backwards, but the future of the liberal international organisation has been a matter of concern, d finland and the EU are at the forefront. State of the national economy 2017 d kssnne for the better Why, then, is the state of Finland's national economy in autumn 2017? Our growth rate is currently the fastest in the euro area. However, the boom in Finland began with a d catching up. In addition to domestic demand and construction investments, exports and productive investment have been linked to the water. Domestic demand growth has been driven by a very accommodative monetary policy stance in Finland and other euro area countries. Low interest rates reduce the level of interest rates and increases consumption and investment. The ECB's purchase programmes have supported bank lending. As a result, interest rates on loans to households and non-financial corporations have fallen to exceptionally low levels. Nevertheless, it is good to remember that monetary policy alone can only have an impact on economic growth in a short period of time d oettei kurki die before the swamp melts. Sustainable growth is created by strengthening productivity, supply and investment. Domestic economic policies have improved export competitiveness. Measures to balance public finances, together with the acceleration of growth, are now creating a more dynamic situation for households and businesses. All of this is in the form of improved confidence in households and businesses. There has been a lot of talk about the Kiky Agreement lately. In the light of statistical data, the agreement will lead to a clear reduction in the price of Finnish jobs in relation to competitor countries. At the beginning of 2017, the price of wages in Finland fell by about one and a half per cent year-on-year, measured by the labour cost index. At the same time, in the euro area it rose by just over one per cent, in Germany and Sweden by two per cent. The business world is not in favour of it. It is the case that the competitiveness of Finnish work and production is now being restored to the level of competitor countries by means of the Kiky Agreement. Now it's a round of unions. The Finnish model based on the ability to pay wages in the export sector did not emerge in theory, but it can be done together. The negotiators are very much on guard for Finland's growth and stupidity. I wish you success in order to achieve a solution that is supportive of growth, enterprise and employment. The improved situation of the export industry is bringing much-needed additional income to the national economy, both directly and directly. Although the industry itself has not been able to increase its importance, the improved export industries have accelerated productive investment, increased demand for services and strengthened employment. The structural friction problems in the tys market are accentuated by such a situation. Now they are starting to see a significant shortage of labour in some sectors. It is difficult to overemphasise the importance of the functioning of the labour market in order to safeguard the conditions for economic growth and to increase the employment rate. Deeper than the surface:Finnish companies and productivity I started with a story of the growth of the standard of living of our national economy. The growth in living standards should have slowed down due to the longterm low productivity development. Looking at the productivity figures at the macro level, one can easily get the impression that Finnish companies have been in an anemic state. A closer look reveals that some companies have continued to grow strongly throughout the 2000s. At the same time, however, the vast majority of companies have had productivity in place. Of course, the fact that some are doing well is not a problem. The problem is that others don't stay asss. Indeed, obstacles to productivity growth for other enterprises may have increased d it may be that the costs of the transition from a production-based economy to the information society have increased. Productivity growth is generated not only by innovation, but also by their spread from innovator companies to other enterprises. The divergence of the forefront from other companies may indicate that the slow uptake of the latest technology is 2.3 a bigger problem than a lack of innovation. International research highlights the fact that the renewal of enterprises is a key driver of employment and productivity growth. Some of the variations in employment, productivity and production over time (up to 40%) are explained by factors affecting the emergence of enterprises and the HCV. The direct lead from the study is that among the new companies, things are done better and more efficiently than in existing ones, and new enterprises force the old ones to renew themselves.4 Why, then, is productivity in companies so cherished? At the macro level, productivity growth is reflected in an increase in living standards. At the enterprise level, on the other hand, differences in productivity are reflected in the profitability of enterprises. According to studies carried out by the Bank of Finland, profitable companies are profitable, high productivity is reflected in wages, and high productivity goes hand in hand with export success.5 The underlying factors for productivity growth are known.6 These include dismantling barriers to competition, supporting innovation, developing skills, improving the efficiency of financing (e.g. dismantling and simplifying barriers to risk investing), business management (e.g. a better link between productivity and wages), ownership (e.g. attracting foreign investment and participating domestic companies in global value chains) and taxation. For example, the entrepreneurship programme of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Employment includes many elements, such as the liberalisation of shop opening hours and deregulation projects, facilitating the recruitment of top foreign talent and improving export financing. An active innovation policy on the part of the public authorities is justified, because otherwise the private sector would invest in innovation as much as would be desirable for society. Attention has also been paid to the Enterprise Package in the form of innovation vouchers for SMEs, which have proved to be a popular tool for renewing the company's activities. Good ladies and gentlemen, Looking at the longer term in the arc, the rise in the standard of living in 100-year-old Finland is a success story. Although we have had weaker years over the past ten years, they are now brighter. Employment has begun to improve, which can be supported by reforms. The ECB's light monetary policy supports growth and employment. The competitiveness of Finnish tysn and production is being corrected once the line is in line. However, it is not the national economy that creates the standard of living, but the companies operating in the economy. The rise in our future standard of living will depend on how our economy and businesses are to be renewed in the long term. I wish finnish companies and entrepreneurs every success! Tuesday 5September 2017, 2:00 PM Johtokunnan jsen Olli Rehn Suomen Pankki Juhlapuhe Yrittjn pivn pjuhlassa Suomen kasvutarina ja yritysten tuottavuus Korjaamo, Helsinki 5.9.2017 (PDF) (/globalassets/fi/media-ja-julkaisut/puheet/documents/2017-09-05_yrittajan-paiva_final_olli_rehn.pdf) SUOMEN KASVUTARINA JA YRITYSTEN TUOTTAVUUS Arvoisat yrittjt ja yritysten edustajat, hyvt naiset ja herrat, Suomen taloudessa eletn vihdoin kasvun aikaa. Kuluneen vuoden aikana yksittisi yrityksi koskevat hyvt uutiset ovat vahvistuneet koko talouden kasvuksi. Kasvu on laaja-alaistunut kulutusvetoisesta kysynnst mys investointeihin ja viennin virkoamiseen. Suomalaisten yritysten nkymt ovat aiempaa selvsti paremmat. Kaskimailta digiyhteiskunnaksi Tnn onkin sopiva tilaisuus tarkastella 100 vuotiaan Suomen nousua kaskimailta ja tervanpoltosta digiyhteiskunnaksi, jossa yhtlt monet teollistumisen alkuajan yritykset ovat edelleen osa tarinaamme  ja uudemmat tulokkaat tuovat uusia tuulia tulevaan menestykseemme. Viel 1800-luvun puolivlin jlkeen Suomi oli kyh maa muihin lnsimaihin verrattuna. Elintasomme on monella mittarilla parantunut merkittvsti noista ajoista. Kansantuotteella henke kohden mitaten suomalaisten elintaso 1on 150 vuodessa kasvanut noin 25-kertaiseksi. Viime aikoihin saakka suomalaisten elintason kasvu on nopeutunut. Vuodesta 1860 alkaen elintason kaksinkertaistumiseen kului 50 vuotta. Sodista huolimatta seuraava kaksinkertaistuminen saavutettiin 40 vuoden kuluessa. Sotien jlkeen talouskasvu kiihtyi, ja elintaso kaksinkertaistui 20 vuoden ajassa kaksi kertaa. Vauhti nytt kuitenkin hidastuneen. Se liittyy tuottavuuskasvun hidastumiseen, mihin palaan hetken pst. Yksi avaintekij Suomen 150-vuotisen elintason nousun taustalla on ollut maamme integroituminen kansainvliseen talouteen. Teollistuminen on perustunut kansainvliseen kauppaan ja sen mahdollistamaan erikoistumiseen. Metsteollisuus, jonka raaka-aineita lytyy runsaasti kotimaasta, on tst oiva esimerkki. Sama ptee myhemmin metalli-ja teknologiateollisuuteen ja tnn lisksi vaikkapa ohjelmisto-ja peliteollisuuteen. Mys palvelujen ulkomaankauppa on kasvanut. Vapaakauppa ja liberaali kansainvlinen jrjestys onkin ollut Suomen kasvutarinan yksi kulmakivi. Siksi emme voi hiljaa seurata sit, ett tuon liberaalin jrjestyksen luojat, Yhdysvallat ja Britannia, nyt itse heikentvt sen perustaa. Euroopan unioni on tss tilanteessa johdonmukaisesti puolustanut monenkeskist kauppajrjestelm ja solminut uusia kahdenvlisi vapaakauppasopimuksia. Mys Kiinan suunnalta on kuultu vastaavia puheenvuoroja vapaakaupan puolesta. Globalisaatio ei ole viel ottanut takapakkia, mutta liberaalin kansainvlisen jrjestyksen tulevaisuudesta on pidettv huolta  siin Suomi ja EU ovat eturintamassa. Kansantalouden tila 2017  knne parempaan Mik sitten on Suomen kansantalouden tila syksyll 2017? Kasvuvauhtimme on tll hetkell euroalueen nopeinta. Noususuhdanne Suomessa alkoi kuitenkin myhn  kiinni kurottavaa riitt. Kotimaisen kysynnn ja rakennusinvestointien ohella vienti ja tuotannolliset investoinnit ovat lhteneet vetmn. Kotimaisen kysynnn kasvun taustalla on ollut Suomessa ja mys muissa euroalueen maissa hyvin elvyttv rahapolitiikka. Alhainen korkotaso vhent sstmist ja lis kulutusta ja investointeja. EKP:n osto-ohjelmat ovat tukeneet pankkien lainanantoa. Sek kotitalouksien ett yrityslainojen korot ovat laskeneet poikkeuksellisen alhaisiksi. Silti on hyv muistaa ett rahapolitiikalla yksistn voidaan vaikuttaa talouskasvuun vain lyhyehkll aikavlill  ettei kurki kuole ennen kuin suo sulaa. Kestvn kasvun evt luodaan tuottavuutta, tyn tarjontaa ja investointeja vahvistamalla. Kotimaisella talouspolitiikalla on parannettu viennin kilpailukyky. Julkista taloutta tasapainottavat toimet yhdess kasvun kiihtymisen kanssa luovat nyt mynteisemp nkym kotitalouksille ja yrityksille. Tm kaikki nkyy kotitalouksien ja yritysten luottamuksen paranemisena. Kiky-sopimuksesta on viime aikoina puhuttu paljon. Tilastotietojen valossa sopimuksen ansiosta suomalaisen tyn hinta alenee tnvuonna selvsti suhteessa kilpailijamaihin. Vuoden 2017 alussa tynhinta Suomessa laski noin puolitoista prosenttia vuotta aiemmasta tykustannusindeksill mitattuna. Samaan aikaan euroalueella se nousi runsaan prosentin, Saksassa ja Ruotsissa kaksi prosenttia. Tt ei yrityskentss kannata mielestni vheksy. Trkeint on, ett tyllisyys kohenee, kun kiky-sopimuksen avulla suomalaisen tyn ja tuotannon kilpailukyky ollaan nyt palauttamassa kilpailijamaiden tasolle. Nyt edess on liittokierros. Vientisektorin palkanmaksukykyyn nojaavaa Suomen mallia ei syntynyt teoriassa, mutta kytnnss se voidaan yh tehd. Neuvottelijat ovatkin paljon vartijoina Suomen kasvun ja tyllisyyden kannalta. Toivotan menestyst kasvua, yrittjyytt ja tyllisyytt tukevan ratkaisun saavuttamiseksi. Vientiteollisuuden parantunut tilanne tuo kansantalouteen kipesti kaivattuja listuloja sek suoraan ett epsuorasti. Vaikka teollisuus itsessn ei ole lisnnytkn merkittvsti tyllisyytt, vientiteollisuuden parantuneet nkymt ovat kiihdyttneet tuotannollisia investointeja, lisnneet palveluiden kysynt ja nin vahvistaneet tyllisyytt. Tymarkkinoiden rakenteelliset kitkaongelmat korostuvat tllaisessa tilanteessa. Nyt ne nkyvt siin, ett joillakin aloilla alkaa olla merkittvkin tyvoimapulaa. On vaikea korostaa liikaa tymarkkinoiden toiminnan merkityst talouskasvun edellytysten turvaamiseksi ja tyllisyysasteen nostamiseksi. Pintaa syvemmlle:Suomen yritykset ja tuottavuus Aloitin kansantaloutemme elintason kasvutarinalla. Elintason kasvu nyttisi hidastuneen johtuen pitklti heikosta tuottavuuskehityksest. Makrotason tuottavuuslukuja katsellessa syntyy helposti mielikuva ett suomalaiset yritykset ovat olleet aneemisessa tilassa. Tarkempi tarkastelu paljastaa, ett osassa yrityksi tuottavuuskasvu on jatkunut vahvana lhes koko 2000-luvun ajan. Samaan aikaan valtaosalla yrityksist kuitenkin tuottavuus on madellut lhes paikoillaan. Se, ett osalla menee hyvin, ei tietysti ole ongelma. Ongelma on se, etteivt muut pysy perss. Tuottavuuden kasvun esteet muille yrityksille ovatkin mahdollisesti kasvaneet  voi olla, ett siirtymiskustannukset tuotantoon perustuvasta taloudesta tietoyhteiskuntaan ovat nousseet. Tuottavuuskasvu syntyy innovaatioiden ohella mys niiden levimisest innovaattoriyrityksist muihin yrityksiin. Eturintaman erkaantuminen muista yrityksist voi viitata siihen, ett uusimman teknologian hidas kyttnotto on 2,3 suurempi ongelma kuin innovaatioiden puute. Kansainvlinen tutkimus korostaa sit, ett yritysten uusiutuminen on keskeinen tyllisyyden ja tuottavuuskasvun lhde. Merkittv osa tyllisyyden, tuottavuuden ja tuotannon vaihteluista yli ajan (jopa 40 %) selittyy yritysten syntymiseen ja hvimiseen vaikuttavilla tekijill. Suora johtopts tutkimuksesta on, ett merkittvss joukossa uusia yrityksi asiat tehdn paremmin ja tehokkaammin kuin jo olemassa olevissa yrityksiss, ja uudet yritykset pakottavat vanhat uusiutumaan.4 Miksi sitten tuottavuus yrityksiss on niin trke? Makrotasolla tuottavuuskasvu heijastuu elintason kasvuun. Yritystasolla taas tuottavuuserot heijastuvat yritysten kannattavuuteen. Suomen Pankissakin tehtyjen tutkimusten mukaan kannattavat yritykset tyllistvt, korkea tuottavuus heijastuu palkkoihin ja korkea tuottavuus kulkee yhdess vientimenestyksen kanssa.5 Tuottavuuskasvun taustatekijit tunnetaan.6 Niit ovat mm. kilpailun esteiden purkaminen, innovaatiotoiminnan tukeminen, osaamisen kehittminen, rahoituksen vlityksen tehostaminen (esim. poma/riskisijoittamisen esteiden purkaminen ja yksinkertaistaminen), yritysten johtaminen (esim. parempi yhteys tuottavuuden ja palkkojen vlill), omistajuus (esim. ulkomaisten investointien houkuttelu ja kotimaisten yritysten osallistuminen globaaleihin arvoketjuihin) ja verotus. Esimerkiksi TEM:n yrittjyysohjelmassa on monia nit elementtej, kuten kauppojen aukioloaikojen vapauttaminen ja norminpurkuhankkeet, ulkomaisten huippuosaajien rekrytoinnin helpottaminen sek viennin rahoituksen parantaminen. Julkisen vallan aktiivinen innovaatiopolitiikka on perusteltua, koska muuten yksityinen sektori investoisi innovaatiotoimintaan vhemmn kuin olisi yhteiskunnan kannalta toivottavaa. Thn on mys kiinnitetty huomiota yrittjyyspaketissa pk-yrityksille suunnattujen innovaatiosetelien muodossa, jotka ovat osoittautuneet suosituksi vlineeksi uudistaa yrityksen toimintaa. Hyvt naiset ja herrat, Pidemmss kaaressa katsoen 100-vuotiaan Suomen elintason nousu on menestystarina. Vaikka olemme kuluneen kymmenen vuoden aikana nhneet heikompia vuosia, ovat nkymt nyt valoisammat. Tyllisyys on alkanut kohenemaan, mit voidaan uudistuksilla tukea. EKP:n kevyt rahapolitiikka tukee kasvua ja tyllisyytt. Suomalaisen tyn ja tuotannon kilpailukyky on korjautumassa, kunhan linja pit. Kansantalous ei kuitenkaan luo elintasoa, vaan taloudessa toimivat yritykset. Tulevaisuuden elintasomme nousu riippuu pitklti siit, kuinka taloutemme ja yrityksemme uusiutuvat.
